title: HeartAttackPrediction
summary: A machine learning project that predicts heart disease from clinical attributes, comparing classification models before and after augmenting the training data with synthetic samples. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and evaluation utilities (run_diagnostic, evaluate_quality) to generate and validate synthetic tabular data for augmentation.
